name: ASBO Labs
changelog:
1.3.0-beta.3

  • Removes the extra Add to project / Save for later interaction; Items now auto-update the local beta project as quantities, decoration, and variations change.
  • Restores fee and incentive identifiers in the sticky footer: $15 digitizing/setup when applicable, waived for artwork already on file, $10 flat-rate shipping, and 10K stitch allowance messaging.
  • Removes product category labels from the product list and adds a product details module in the selected product area.
  • Replaces the selected-product header with a per-piece quantity pricing table and current-tier summary.
  • Updates the Labs naming in the front-end UI and editor placeholder.
  • Adds Gutenberg inspector controls for product category, product count, beta bar visibility, and contained/wide/full section width.
  • Extends the footer across the selected section width while preserving the separate Labs beta updater and leaving production latest.json unchanged.
